rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something operating or happening automatically.

example.english: The machine automatically starts up as soon as it is plugged in.
example.traditional: 部機一插電就自動開機。
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 jat1 caap3 din6 zau6 zi6 dung6 hoi1 gei1

rows.note: Use this when something happens by itself, without another person making it happen.

example.english: I didn't touch the switch, but the machine automatically turned on by itself.
example.traditional: 我冇掂個掣，但部機自己著咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mou5 dim6 go3 zai3 daan6 bou6 gei1 zi6 gei2 zoek6 zo2
